scope: Source-only preparation and baseline training; no final clinical test

preprocessing.montage_policy: Exact case-insensitive names only; no missing-channel interpolation or zero filling
preprocessing.reference: Common average of the exact selected 11 channels
preprocessing.filter: Per-trial-context fourth-order Butterworth SOS, scipy sosfiltfilt odd padding
preprocessing.resample: scipy resample_poly, Kaiser 5, no learned transformation
preprocessing.time_anchor: MOABB 1.7.2 canonical task annotation; adapter interval shift already applied
preprocessing.units: MNE Raw SI volts; saved float32 volts
preprocessing.qc_policy: Flag and retain; incomplete 3s contexts explicitly excluded; other data-integrity failure stops
preprocessing.downstream_normalization: Each trial/channel temporal demeaning, then joint trial RMS; no cross-trial or target statistic

classical.CSP: Helmert CAR subspace; trace-normalized trial covariances; 0.1 shrinkage; dataset/person/class balanced means; two low plus two high generalized eigenvectors; log power
classical.LDA: sklearn lsqr, shrinkage auto, equal class priors; fit rows not sample weighted
classical.TS: Trace-normalized 0.1-shrunk covariances; training-only weighted log-Euclidean reference; whitened matrix log and sqrt(2) upper triangle
classical.LR: Training-only weighted StandardScaler; C=1, lbfgs, max_iter=2000; equal dataset/person/class weights
classical.seeds: Deterministic models run once per fold; seed aliases not counted as independent fits

neural.architecture: Compact EEGNet-family independent implementation; temporal63, F1=8, D=2, F2=16, depthwise15, pooling4/8
neural.selection: Source LODO participant-balanced validation cross-entropy only
neural.sampling: Equal dataset, person, then observed class, with replacement
neural.resume: All optimizer and PyTorch/sampler RNG state at epoch boundary; exact same identity/device
